{{- /* The social row under the legal line, rendered once, as the rebranded footer does. (The pre-rebrand footer rendered it twice with display utilities to move it around the copyright; `flex-column` on .gd-footer-bottom made that unnecessary and the theme dropped it.) The type branches are production's. The feed currently carries four `social` entries and nothing else — "Subscribe for updates" moved into the banner links as an `action: subscribe` item, which footer.html filters out — so only the four icons render. Keeping the `secondary` branch means we follow suit if marketing ever emits it again. Social icons get an aria-label from the feed's `text`, as production does, because the link's only content is an SVG. The feed's icons are dark 48px tiles; footer-icon.html cuts the tile off, publishes the glyph as a shared file, and paints it in currentColor so the button follows the theme. Expects: buttons (the feed's array); optional class. */ -}} {{- with .buttons }}
{{- range . }} {{- if eq .type "social" }} {{- partial "footer-link.html" (dict "item" (dict "title" .text "link" .link) "class" "gd-footer-icon" "idPrefix" "footer-btn-" "icon" (partial "footer-icon.html" .icon) "ariaLabel" .text "rel" "noreferrer noopener") }} {{- else if eq .type "secondary" }} {{- partial "footer-link.html" (dict "item" (dict "title" .text "link" .link) "class" "gd-footer-btn" "idPrefix" "footer-btn-") }} {{- end }} {{- end }}
{{- end }}
